paper_fill_rules: PAPER backtest of Stocktimus recommendations, not Jesse's actual fills. Assume each emailed ticket filled at the inventory stock_price and premium_per_share on the email date, sized as printed (CC with no size => 100 sh / 1 call). taken stays proposed except LULU (taken=no, status=out). Invalidation uses completed Yahoo daily CLOSE only (session 2026-09-22 is CLOSED after 1pm PT; today's close MAY be used for invalidation). A. Invalidated stock+CC: stock P&L=(close-entry)*100*contracts; call credit KEPT; no invented buy-to-close (no same-day option print) — FLAG. A. Invalidated CSP: paper P&L = credit - max(0,strike-close)*100*contracts; time value unknown. A. Invalidated long call: P&L = max(0,close-strike)*100*contracts - debit; time value unknown. B. Still open: CBOE mid=(bid+ask)/2 if both>0 else last if>0 else blank. stock+CC unrealized=(live-entry)*100*n + credit - live_call_mark*100*n. CSP unrealized=credit - live_put_mark*100*n. long call unrealized=live_call_mark*100*n - debit. C. Expiry-day contracts settle intrinsic-only at expiry close (no time value). stock+CC ITM (close>strike): (expiry_close-entry)*100*n + credit - max(0,close-strike)*100*n. If close<=strike (OTM): call expires 0 and credit kept; leftover shares stay OPEN (paper_status=leftover_shares) MTM at live mark — stock exit is NEXT RTH open (Fri weekly -> Monday open); do NOT use expiry close as final stock exit. CSP expired: credit - max(0,strike-close)*100*n. Long call expired: max(0,close-strike)*100*n - debit. D. LULU already OUT midday 8/17: paper_status=out. If CBOE still lists Aug 21 120c, MTM at live mid. If CBOE no longer lists the expired Aug 21 120c, CARRY Friday 8/21 last real mark: paper_pnl=-298, live_option_mid=1.16, paper_status=out, flag carried Friday 8/21 CBOE mid 1.16 (last real print). Do not leave LULU unscored and do not invent a new premium. E. IREN/NVO/ZETA distinct tickets scored independently. IREN 42.50c 8/19 noon + 8/20 AM are reprints of 8/19 AM — scored once; credit note 1.17→1.42. IREN 8/20 noon 42c is a different strike from 42.50c — scored independently. IREN 8/21 noon 43c Aug 28 is a NEW overlay — scored independently. PFE 8/20 28c is an unused-alternative to 8/19 28.50c — both scored, not both assumed filled. PFE 8/21 noon 28c Aug 28 is a new week overlay — scored independently of 8/20 AM 28c. CSV ids 1-4 were not in any Stocktimus briefing email — tracker-only group. Aug 13 noon HIMS 30c / JD 30c / IREN 45c / ASTS 70p are emailed and were missing from the CSV.
